result.summary: The image shows an urban street with sidewalks on both sides but a complete lack of marked pedestrian crossing infrastructure at a signalized intersection. Large temporary orange barriers and parked vehicles create visual obstructions, while the absence of crosswalks and pedestrian signals significantly reduces safety for those crossing the street.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crosswalks
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at this signalized intersection, leaving pedestrians without a designated or protected path.

hazards.name: Temporary barriers obstructing sightlines
hazards.description: Large orange plastic barriers in the roadway can block the view between drivers and pedestrians, especially children.

hazards.name: Poor pavement condition
hazards.description: The roadway surface is cracked and uneven, which can cause tripping hazards for pedestrians crossing.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on when it is safe to cross.

interventions.title: Curb Ramps and Daylighting
interventions.description: Install ADA-compliant curb ramps and remove parking/obstructions near the corner to improve visibility and accessibility.

result.summary: This narrow residential street features sidewalks on both sides but lacks any marked crossings or pedestrian safety infrastructure. The high density of parked vehicles creates significant sightline obstructions for anyone attempting to cross the roadway.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Continuous lines of parked cars on both sides of the street block the view of pedestrians from oncoming drivers.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Infrastructure
hazards.description: Absence of marked crosswalks or signage at the intersection increases the risk of conflicts.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking near the intersection to improve visibility for all road users.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at the corner to reduce crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalk markings to designate safe crossing points.

result.summary: The intersection features a sidewalk with a curb ramp and tactile paving, but lacks marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals. The roadway is wide and unmarked, creating an environment where pedestrians must navigate vehicle traffic without dedicated crossing infrastructure.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at the intersection, making pedestrian movements less predictable for drivers.
